categories.main_business_segments: Chengdu JOUAV Automation Tech Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, development, production, sales, and services of industrial drones. Its product portfolio includes vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL) fixed-wing drones, multi-rotor drones, large fixed-wing drones, unmanned helicopter systems, and unmanned unattended systems. The company also provides drone flight data services and drone pilot training. It serves multiple industries such as surveying and mapping, inspection, security monitoring, emergency response, and defense.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has core technologies in intelligent flight control, aircraft platform design and manufacturing, and integrated cloud-edge-end systems. It employs advanced composite material manufacturing, modular design, and multi-objective optimization for drone platforms. Key technologies include autonomous flight control algorithms, distributed flight control systems, multi-platform networking and formation control, GNSS-denied navigation using visual SLAM, and cloud-edge integrated command and control platforms. Production follows a make-to-order model with in-house manufacturing of core components and outsourced processing for mature non-core parts.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include government agencies, state-owned enterprises, research institutes, and private enterprises in sectors such as energy (power grid inspection), surveying and mapping, public security, emergency management, forestry, agriculture, and smart city applications. The company also serves international markets in Southeast Asia, Africa, and South America. Its drones are widely used for industrial applications including emergency communication, forest fire prevention, geological disaster monitoring, urban management, and environmental monitoring.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Chengdu, Sichuan Province. It has established subsidiaries and offices in multiple Chinese cities including Zhengzhou, Shenzhen, Urumqi, and Hangzhou. Overseas sales focus on Southeast Asia, Africa, and South America. The company actively collaborates with various provincial and municipal governments across China to develop low-altitude economy demonstration projects and application scenarios.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chengdu JOUAV operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the industrial drone supply chain. It designs, manufactures, and assembles drone platforms and flight control systems, integrates mission payloads, and provides data services and training. The company controls core component production such as composite airframes and avionics but outsources some mature non-core manufacturing processes. It also develops software platforms and cloud services, positioning itself as a comprehensive drone system provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation in drone autonomy, intelligent control, and cloud-edge integration. It invests heavily in R&D for new drone models, unmanned unattended systems, AI-driven data processing, and low-altitude economy applications. Strategic R&D projects include VTOL fixed-wing drones, multi-rotor drones with advanced payloads, large fixed-wing drones, and integrated cloud platforms. The company also focuses on AI, 5G, and big data to enhance autonomous flight, mission planning, and data analytics, aiming to lead the low-altitude digital economy.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of industrial drones and related systems, including fixed-wing, multi-rotor, and unattended drone platforms. Additional revenue streams include drone flight data services, training services for drone pilots, and software platform subscriptions. The company employs a direct sales and distributor model domestically and internationally. It also benefits from government procurement projects and strategic partnerships in emerging low-altitude economy sectors.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Chengdu JOUAV is one of the leading and most competitive industrial drone companies in China, recognized as a national specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise. It holds a strong market position due to its early entry and leadership in VTOL fixed-wing drones and comprehensive product portfolio. The company competes with other domestic and international drone manufacturers but differentiates itself through advanced technology, integrated solutions, and extensive industry applications. It ranks among the top five global civil drone manufacturers according to external evaluations.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved record revenue of approximately RMB 474.2 million, representing a 57.14% year-over-year increase. Despite continued net losses of RMB 35.8 million, the loss narrowed by 44.51% compared to the previous year. Total assets grew by 12.41% to RMB 1.057 billion, while equity attributable to shareholders slightly decreased by 5.91% to RMB 569.7 million. The company increased R&D investment by 27.22% to RMB 92.4 million, reflecting a strong growth trajectory supported by expanding orders and market opportunities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its strong independent R&D capabilities, advanced intelligent flight control, modular and scalable drone platforms, and integrated cloud-edge-end systems. Its drones feature long endurance, high payload capacity, autonomous operation including obstacle avoidance, and adaptability to complex terrains. The comprehensive product ecosystem supports diverse industry applications with high reliability and ease of use. The company also offers a robust software platform and AI-enabled data analytics, enabling customers to leverage drone-collected spatial data for enhanced operational efficiency and decision-making.
